question: When comes Maya-purusha discrimination, and who stays above Maya?
premises: then Maya-purusha discrimination from all-karma destruction
vijnanakala-state below Maya does not go
inference: Karma-exhaustion discriminates Maya from purusha; the knower stays up, man sinks.
plain_english: Then Maya-purusha discrimination from all-karma destruction becomes — vijnanakala-state below Maya does not go; down goes the man.
